title: Webinar 89: Creative Commons @ 25 years
content:
Happy Friday – we hope you are keeping safe and warm with storms hitting the UK at the moment! We have exciting news about our Copyright Waffle webinar schedule with our November and December webinars now available for booking.

On Friday 27th November from 10.30-12pm (GMT) we are pleased to be hosting our 89th webinar where we are joined by Brigitte Vézina the Director of Policy at Creative Commons. The webinar requires registration but is open to all.

This year, Creative Commons marks 25 years of powering the world’s open sharing—a quarter century of building the legal, technical, and social infrastructure that enables open knowledge, creativity, and collaboration worldwide. Today, CC licenses and tools from an integral part of the open infrastructure and have enabled the sharing of bilions of works in the commons — from scholarly publishing to new art and creativity, all the way to OERs and more.
